title: A pre-merge check's declared postgres service runs beside it in a real merge trial
description: A fixture's preMerge check declares a stock postgres Compose service and queries it at $GRAPHYARD_SERVICE_DB_HOST:$GRAPHYARD_SERVICE_DB_PORT. A real merge trial starts the service on its own Compose network, waits for it to accept TCP, and runs the check joined to that network: a working query passes, a failing one fails the check, and no container is left either way.

steps.name: a real trial runs the check beside its postgres service and removes it
